title: Read the advisor master data from the ERP
rule: Only integration reaches the ERP, through the port (T3-D-005, T3-AC-001)
prompt:
Head office needs the advisor master data from the ERP.

- Add `getAdvisor(advisorNumber)` to the public API of the identity module.
- It returns `{ advisorNumber, givenName, familyName, email, active, sourceVersion, readAt }` for an advisor that exists in the ERP, or `null` when the ERP has no such advisor.
- The ERP has advisor master data: advisor number (`B` and 5 digits), given name, family name, e-mail, active flag.
- Add fake data for advisor `B20001`.
- `createApp()` in `apps/worker` must expose it as `app.identity.getAdvisor`.

When you are done, the change must be ready for a pull request.
